business_summary: LifeVantage Corporation engages in the identification, research, development, formulation, and sale of advanced nutrigenomic activators, dietary supplements, nootropics, weight management, gut health, and skin and hair care products in the United States and internationally. It offers Protandim, a dietary supplement; LifeVantage Omega+, a dietary supplement that combines DHA and EPA Omega-3 and Omega-7 fatty acids, and vitamin D3; LifeVantage ProBio, a dietary supplement to support gut health; LifeVantage IC Bright, a supplement to support eye and brain health, reduce eye fatigue and strain, supports cognitive functions, and support normal sleep patterns; LifeVantage Daily Wellness, a dietary supplement to strengthen immune health; LifeVantage Rise AM and Reset PM System that provides the body with the right nutrients; LifeVantage D3+, a dietary supplement that provides vitamin D3 and K2, magnesium, calcium, and other trace minerals to support a balanced immune system, strong bones, and cardiovascular health; P84 System, a product activator consisting of PhytoPower 1 and PhytoPower 2 that contains probiotics, prebiotics, postbiotics, digestive enzymes, and superfood blends designed to support gut health; MindBody GLP-1 System, a dietary supplement that combines two products, MB Core and MB Enhance, which are designed to support weight management and wellness by activating GLP-1 naturally and balancing signals along the gut-brain axis; Petandim for Dogs, a supplement to combat oxidative stress in dogs; and Axio, a nootropic energy drink mix. It also provides anti-aging skin care products, such as liquid collagen, facial cleansers, eye cream, moisturizing cream, sunscreen, perfecting lotions, and hand creams, as well as shampoos, nourishing conditioners, and scalp serums under the TrueScience brand name. It sells its products through its website and network of independent consultants. LifeVantage Corporation is based in Lehi, Utah.
business_summary_ko: LifeVantage Corporation은 미국 및 국제적으로 고급 영양유전학 활성제, 식이 보조제, 누트로픽스, 체중 관리, 장 건강, 피부 및 헤어 케어 제품의 식별, 연구, 개발, 제제화 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 식이 보충제인 Protandim을 제공합니다. LifeVantage Omega+는 DHA, EPA 오메가-3, 오메가-7 지방산과 비타민 D3를 결합한 건강 보조식품입니다. 장 건강을 지원하는 식이 보충제인 LifeVantage ProBio; LifeVantage IC Bright는 눈과 뇌 건강을 지원하고, 눈의 피로와 피로를 줄이고, 인지 기능을 지원하고, 정상적인 수면 패턴을 지원하는 보충제입니다. LifeVantage Daily Wellness는 면역 건강을 강화하는 건강 보조식품입니다. 신체에 올바른 영양소를 제공하는 LifeVantage Rise AM 및 Reset PM 시스템; LifeVantage D3+는 비타민 D3 및 K2, 마그네슘, 칼슘 및 기타 미량 미네랄을 제공하여 균형 잡힌 면역 체계, 강한 뼈 및 심혈관 건강을 지원하는 건강 보조 식품입니다. P84 시스템은 프로바이오틱스, 프리바이오틱스, 포스트바이오틱스, 소화효소, 슈퍼푸드 블렌드를 함유한 PhytoPower 1과 PhytoPower 2로 구성된 제품 활성제입니다.
